repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
wait until(any(#HumiditySensor).humiditySensor_humidity < 30|)
delay(3 SEC)
all(#Speaker).speaker_speak("Humidity is low")

diagnosis.summary: The IR uses a slot `any` for HumiditySensor, requiring an existential quantifier (`<|`). The candidate used `all` (universal), which failed because `Bedroom_HumiditySensor.humidity` was null (unavailable), causing the condition to be false even though `LivingRoom_HumiditySensor.humidity` was 0.0. Evidence F2 confirms the JoI emitted no action while the IR did.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the comparison operator from `all(...).humiditySensor_humidity < 30` to `any(...).humiditySensor_humidity < 30|` to match the `any` binding slot. The `|` suffix ensures the condition is true if at least one device satisfies it, ignoring unavailable sensors.
